title: Does a refusal probe distinguish genuine safety refusals from capability-based 'I can't' refusals?

original_idea.body: Build a dataset of safety refusals, capability refusals, and compliances, test whether a single refusal direction separates safety vs capability refusals, and compare to a judge model.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: refusal typing aids over-refusal/sandbagging detection, but link skips a step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Three-class refusal dataset + probe separability; beginner-feasible.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Monitoring interpretability on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Refusal probing studied; safety-vs-capability disambiguation may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Refusal typing may be partly open.
